From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechx.com>, Elena Torres <procure@fintechx.com>

Subject: Re: Unit economics deep dive — follow-up & next steps

Samir / Elena —

Appreciate the numbers — that gives us a great starting point. I populated the attached workbook with three scenarios (High-touch hosted, Dedicated reserved, and Committed-discount). Below is a concise unit-econ summary tailored to your 10M / month baseline.

Assumptions (baseline):
- Baseline tokens: 1M tokens = 1,000,000 tokens.
- Avg tokens per feature call (FintechX mix): 2,500 tokens (weighted average across short & long calls).
- Calls per 1M tokens = 1,000,000 / 2,500 = 400 calls.

Redwood estimated inference costs (blended):
- Hosted (on-demand): $95 / 1M tokens (including compute, runtime, and basic support)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): $65 / 1M tokens (reserved pricing, better utilization)
- Blended operating overhead (SRE, networking, storage): add $12–$20 / 1M tokens on top depending on retention & logging

Scenario (example pricing we can offer):
- Price A (hosted list): $1,000 / 1M tokens
  - $/feature = $1,000 / 400 = $2.50 per feature call
  - Gross margin vs hosted cost = (1,000 - 95 - 15) / 1,000 = 89.0% (using $15 overhead)

- Price B (dedicated reserved, 12mo commit): $800 / 1M tokens
  - $/feature = $800 / 400 = $2.00 per feature call
  - Gross margin vs dedicated cost = (800 - 65 - 12) / 800 = 90.4%

- Price C (aggressive committed volume discount): $650 / 1M tokens
  - $/feature = $650 / 400 = $1.63 per feature call
  - Gross margin vs dedicated cost = (650 - 65 - 12) / 650 = 89.2%

FintechX example economics (10M tokens / month baseline):
- Revenue/month at Price B ($800): 10 * $800 = $8,000 / month
- Raw inference cost/month at dedicated rate: 10 * $65 = $650 / month
- Gross margin/month = $8,000 - $650 - (10 * $12 overhead) = $8,000 - $650 - $120 = $7,230
- Gross margin % ≈ 90.4%

CAC payback (example):
- Example CAC (mid-market, sales-assisted): $60,000 total (one-time customer acquisition cost)
- Monthly gross contribution (as above): ~$7,230
- Payback months = 60,000 / 7,230 ≈ 8.3 months

Notes & implications:
- The single biggest lever is committed reserved capacity — moving to Dedicated reserved pricing materially reduces per-1M cost and increases margin while also enabling stronger SLA guarantees.
- If FintechX is price-sensitive but can commit to 12–24 months and a min monthly spend, we can get to Price B/C depending on exact commitments.
- If average tokens per call drops (e.g., more short calls), $/feature decreases and margins improve for the same $/1M price.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm which pricing scenario you want modeled first (Host / Dedicated / Committed).
2) I’ll iterate the attached workbook with the exact traffic mix in traffic-mix.csv and send a one-page economics summary + recommended contract terms.
3) If agreeable, I’ll draft a commercial term sheet (non-binding) to show committed tier thresholds and estimated monthly invoices.

Proposed follow-up: Wed 10/07 10:00am PT (I’ll send the invite).

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk the workbook line-by-line.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
